title: Capitalize list items
description: Declare a function named capitalize_list_items. It takes a list as a parameter and it returns a capitalized list of items.
hints: Every string in Python has a .capitalize() method that uppercases just its first letter.
A list comprehension can apply that method to every item in one line.
expected_behavior: Returns a new list where every string item has been capitalized with str.capitalize().
explanation: The list comprehension [item.capitalize() for item in lst] calls .capitalize() on every element, uppercasing its first letter and lowercasing the rest, and collects the results into a new list.
solution:
def capitalize_list_items(lst):
    return [item.capitalize() for item in lst]
